name: Story: the remote sheets at 05:04, then the station is searched (SC11)
notes: STORY steg 6, the morning act. Started by morning_saro once the player is inside SARO. The old SC11's telex (S47SC11: TELEX 05:04 HONDO, then SITE 11, the document sc11_remote) printed on Freeform's own telex in the control room (the telex beat, FS47FreeformSession::QueueTelex), torn off there as any other paper. Then the siege on Freeform's own visit at SARO (the start beat's happening attention_visit, FS47Attention::StartForStory, started for the story past the hold a story script keeps): the mains sag and go; inside with the lights on (the standby generator) it holds and goes; inside in the dark the light comes through the windows, in the yard it stands over the player, as being taken always does. The story waits for its end (ended_attention_visit). The story flag taken is cleared first, so only a taking in this visit counts: then Reyes' night ends at once (morning_end); otherwise Ward (morning_ward). The full tier holds (the clock is at 05:04 at least). Left out: the pale body searching the rooms and the searchlight on a fixed cycle (the old chapter's own siege engine), and the tubes' switch.

beats.title: Remote sheets, Hondo and Site 11
beats.text:
TELEX 05:04  HONDO VALLEY RADIO STATION
SOURCE H-1 ....... RANGE NEGATIVE
FIRST LIMIT ...... 05:29:47
REQUEST PROCEDURE

TELEX 05:05  SITE 11
SOURCE S-11 ...... RANGE NEGATIVE
FIRST LIMIT ...... 05:29:47
SAME DIRECTION AS SARO

(Three stations, three sources, one time. Nobody asked for a procedure for this.)
The telex wakes: TELEX 05:04 HONDO VALLEY RADIO STATION. SOURCE H-1. RANGE NEGATIVE. FIRST LIMIT 05:29:47.
TELEX 05:05 SITE 11. SOURCE S-11. RANGE NEGATIVE. FIRST LIMIT 05:29:47. SAME DIRECTION AS SARO. The telex stops.
Three stations, three sources, one time.
05:04. Hondo and Site 11 on the telex. Three sources, the same first limit: 05:29:47.
Tear off the remote sheets at the telex. They go with the originals.
Light comes across the control-room windows from outside. Not a car. It moves like someone looking.
Something is searching the building. Keep the lights on and stay inside, off the windows.
